entities.summary: Arati Prabhakar is an American engineer and public official. From October 3, 2022 to January 20, 2025, she served as the 12th director of the White House Office of Science and Technology Policy ("OSTP"). Via her service as OSTP Director, she also served in the President's cabinet.
